::: {#rem-chocolate-strong}
#### Why the proof needs strong induction

The proof of @thm-chocolate uses $P(a)$ and $P(b)$,
where $a$ and $b$ can be any sizes smaller than $n$, not only $n - 1$.
Ordinary induction gives only $P(n - 1)$ in the step.
Strong induction gives $P(k)$ for every $k < n$, which is what the proof needs.

:::
